title.narrative: Surveys of Renewable Marine Resources in the Red Sea State, Sudan; Funded by the Norwegian Embassy Khartoum

description.narrative: The main objectives of the project are to supply new and updated information on renewable marine resource (fish and shellfish stocks) in Republic of the Sudan#s coastal waters, to strengthen capacities and to build the opportunities for the transfer of knowledge and know-how. This will form the knowledge base required for the modernisation of the Sudanese artisanal marine fisheries as well as for the development of a sustainable semi-industrial fishery in the Republic of the Sudan.
